_comment: Human curation gate. Every candidate produced by scripts/lexicon/expand-*.ts must appear in exactly one of {approved, rejected, ambiguous} below, per family. Candidates outside these lists cause `bun run lexicon:build` to exit non-zero, forcing manual triage. Phase-1 baseline = the 36 hardcoded lemmas from src/runtime/speaker-normalization.ts HARDCODED_FALLBACK.
